The current file contains only older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the Cloudberry Kite Components business value change.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-08-23", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "14e5989f-674d-5715-91ad-e38bb23e715b", "subTasks": [{"title": "Request and log estate documents", "text": "Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "dc27a56a-9f8e-5909-959b-cf89e9c02e33", "dueDate": null}, {"title": "Review completeness and role information", "text": "Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "a7eb678b-bf5e-50fc-b01b-eeb80d99a3e0", "dueDate": null}, {"title": "Prepare advisor gap summary", "text": "Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "91e6fcb2-95ab-5fbf-b81c-989b1748ccb3", "dueDate": null}], "evidence": "Evan noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change; an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23."}]}
